_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 28 October to 4 November 2025: Berlin and CERN, the Kremlin, and the bounty.

mentions.claim_text: He says the ice is going to grow, hears it repeated, and that they will have more people helping.
mentions.quote: I see the ice is going to grow. Ice will grow
mentions.falsify_match: Sea or land ice extent increasing measurably.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. No location is given, and polar ice extent is published annually by NSIDC, so a located version of this would be checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He describes underground trails running all the way through California, naming Las Vegas and Los Angeles.
mentions.quote: Underground trails all the way through Las Vegas
mentions.falsify_match: Smuggling or trafficking tunnels found running between those cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None found. Cross-border tunnels near San Diego are documented; a network reaching Las Vegas is not.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that those questioned will squeal and tell all they know, saying the fear of God is put in them.
mentions.quote: that they will tell all they know
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition about informants.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes what he sees as a flex and bragging rights, full of arrogance and anger toward the United States.
mentions.quote: So much arrogance. So angry about the United States
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an attribution of motive with no actor named.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He remarks on how much the Lord shows them on the prayer calls and says he is grateful for the family who join.
mentions.quote: how many things the Lord shows us on these prayer calls
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an aside about the format.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will take care of it in the spirit realm and that they have several weeks left to pray over this, then turns to praying over New York.
mentions.quote: We have got several weeks left to pray over this
mentions.falsify_match: An event in New York within several weeks of 4 November 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurred by early December 2025. Several weeks is the closest thing to a deadline in the New York material.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a schedule of bounties: two thousand dollars for intelligence or doxxing agents including photos and family details, five to ten thousand for kidnapping or non-lethal assault on officers, and up to fifty thousand for higher ranks.
mentions.quote: $2,000 for gathering intelligence or doxxing agents
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a reported bounty schedule read aloud.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the sequence went from babies to Germany and the swastika again, with them summoning the spirit of the Antichrist there.
mentions.quote: I see that swastika again. Them summoning that spirit
mentions.falsify_match: A revival of Nazi-style movement in Germany tied to the figure he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The summoning element has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are doing things underground again in caverns in Germany, in Berlin, summoning the same Hitler spirit by satanic ritual.
mentions.quote: It is in Germany. It is in Berlin
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: underground ritual with no observable signature.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord asking twice why they put CERN where they did, and says it is territorial and there is more to it.
mentions.quote: Why do you think they put CERN where they did?
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a question about siting, with no answer given and no test attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Israel and that he sees Israel and the flag.
mentions.quote: Watch Israel. I see the flag
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to watch with nothing attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Germany, that they are all watching France, that he sees the lizard, and to watch Europe, England and the king.
mentions.quote: Watch Germany. And then I see the lizard
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a list of places to watch.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the thing is made for ceremonies and they are trying to summon it, that the church in Europe needs to step up, and refers to a display that will be seen.
mentions.quote: it is made for ceremonies. But they are trying to summon this thing
mentions.falsify_match: A public ceremony in Europe of the kind described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The display is not specified.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is seeing Romania, Ukraine, Russia and the Kremlin.
mentions.quote: I am seeing Romania. I see Ukraine. I see the Kremlin
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a list of place names.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Romania is the only new one and nothing is attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they picked Switzerland to build CERN, checking the country with someone in the room, and says the Lord brought CERN up.
mentions.quote: Why did they pick Switzerland to build CERN
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a question, with the country confirmed to him in the room. CERN straddles the French-Swiss border near Geneva.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls what he saw about New York City and a hot flash of fire coming out of a building that looked like a major hotel, and gropes for the name.
mentions.quote: that hot flash of fire. It come out of a building
mentions.falsify_match: An explosion or fire originating in a major New York hotel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He cannot retrieve the name, so the building stays unidentified.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not right for him to attack elders or busts on them regardless of their platform, and moves on.
mentions.quote: It is not right for me to attack elders
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of his own practice toward other ministers.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw men coming over from Canada and started to say more before stopping himself, saying he probably said too much.
mentions.quote: I probably said too much
mentions.falsify_match: Hostile actors entering the United States from Canada.
mentions.falsify_miss: None identified. He breaks off mid-sentence, which is a fourth withholding on file.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they would bargain to get seven Democrat votes, and reports being told to pray over that group, seen as a huddle.
mentions.quote: try to get seven Democrat votes
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a comment on the shutdown vote arithmetic already in the news.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw women and children running from Moscow and the Kremlin being hit and struck, describing it as looking like a castle, blown up with strikes all around it.
mentions.quote: I saw the Kremlin being hit and struck
mentions.falsify_match: Strikes on the Kremlin and civilians fleeing Moscow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named building in a named capital, which makes this among the most checkable war claims.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats a reported figure that seven thousand men and women are dying a day in Ukraine and Russia and says he had not realised it.
mentions.quote: 7,000 people a day die in Ukraine and Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a figure he repeats from elsewhere. Published estimates of combined daily casualties, killed and wounded, run in the low thousands, and daily deaths far lower.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says that regardless of the escalation they are still to pray, rejecting the idea that it will happen anyway, and offers to pray for viewers children on the front line.
mentions.quote: Well, it is going to happen anyway, but no, I am still going to pray
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement about why he prays over things he has forecast.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Worth keeping because it is where the prayer-may-prevent structure is stated openly.

mentions.claim_text: He notes South Korea is free to worship unlike China, and prays that Taiwan not be taken over by China, saying he saw Taiwan being taken.
mentions.quote: even Taiwan would not be taken over by China
mentions.falsify_match: China taking Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A petition against something he has separately forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that God hand is on Jamaica and Cuba and that a major revival take place throughout Cuba.
mentions.quote: a MAJOR REVIVAL TAKING PLACE all throughout Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he took a master tie and that it is in this, then says he sees money used to influence into Ukraine.
mentions.quote: Even concerning Ukraine. This money is to influence into Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: US money shown used for political influence in Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None shown. This is the earliest of the three near-identical Ukraine money passages, 29 October 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the Holy Spirit what he is being shown, says he hears Imagine all the people and that it is in New York, then says he saw a flash.
mentions.quote: I hear that imagine all the people. It is in the New York
mentions.falsify_match: An explosion or flash event in New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The earliest of the three Imagine and flash passages, 29 October 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the Supreme Court judges and says he saw a young man rising up in Australia and a major move of God there.
mentions.quote: I saw this young man raising up in Australia
mentions.falsify_match: A young leader emerging in an Australian revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. The man is not named.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks viewers for a hundred dollar gift and says they do not want to be anything but a blessing to them.
mentions.quote: I appreciate $100. Thank you for always being such a blessing
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: acknowledging a donation on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by greeting an international audience, saying he talks to people all over the world, and that they have work to do.
mentions.quote: I talk to people all over the world
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says a woman has enough evidence to run with it and reports the Lord saying that because of what she will expose there will be a price on her head, seen as a price tag of over fifty thousand dollars.
mentions.quote: there will be a price on her head
mentions.falsify_match: A bounty placed on a woman who exposes something significant.
mentions.falsify_miss: None placed. This is the origin of the fifty thousand figure that recurs the following day on the named official.
